entries.mechanism: TAXSIM runs Georgia at its latest 2024 law year: the flat rate was 5.39 per cent under HB 1015 (verified by the TAXSIM marginal slope, e.g. (2,337.20 - 720.20) / 30,000 = 0.0539) against the enacted 2026 schedule rate of 4.99 per cent the pipeline applies, and TAXSIM's 2024 deduction treatment (implied taxable-income offset 16,639 single / 33,276 joint) predates the HB463 standard deduction of 15,000 single / 30,000 joint effective tax year 2026. For the single 30,000-dollar filer the 2026 pipeline reports 748.5 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 720.2, a 28.3-dollar gap — the two-year rate-and-deduction vintage, not a pipeline defect.
